syllabus_topics: Introduction: Kinematics and Dynamics of Particles; Systems of Particles.
Plane Motion of Rigid Bodies: Equations of Motion; Angular Momentum; D'Alembert's Principle; Work and Energy; System of Rigid Bodies; Conservation of Energy and Angular Momentum.
Dynamics of Rigid Bodies in Three Dimensions: Angular Momentum and Kinetic Energy of a Rigid Body in Three Dimensions; Motion of a Gyroscope; Euler Angles; Free Motion of an Axisymmetric Body.
Mechanical Vibrations: Free Vibrations of a Particle and a Rigid Body; Forced Vibrations; Damped Vibrations; Mass-Spring-Damper System.

Tensor Calculus: Index Notation; Summation Convention; Vector Operations; Transformation Laws; Invariance with respect to Coordinate Systems; Metric; Physical Components of Tensors; Covariant Derivative; Curvilinear Acceleration; Differential Operators.
assessment_rules: The final grade NF is calculated as: NF = 0.1*LAB + 0.9*MAX(AVERAGE(MAP_1,MAP_2,MAP_3),ER). LAB is the grade obtained in laboratory tests. MAP_i is the grade obtained in continuous assessment of type MAP45. ER is the grade obtained in the resit exam.
